validity.researcher_notes: P0152 is a real interstate pipeline (ANR Pipeline Company, founded 1945 as Michigan-Wisconsin Pipe Line Company). Wikipedia states it began operations November 1, 1949, running 1,800 miles from Hansford County, Texas Panhandle through OK, KS, NE, MO, IA to Illinois (two legs converging near Chicago). TC Energy acquired ANR in 2007. Pipeline is actively operating and maintained. Verified through Wikipedia, TC Energy operator page (current), and multiple FERC/regulatory documents. System converges near Chicago as recorded.
